title: Digital Output
text: Configure general-purpose input/output pins as digital output, 1 input; {GPIO Group} sets the gPIO pins you want to configure, {GPIO pins for output} sets the gPIO pins you want and {Toggle GPIO#} sets the gPIO pins you want to configure Toggle. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Input
ports.summary: Set the GPIO pin status scalar | vector

params.name: GPIO Group
params.values: GPIO pins you want to configure GPIO0-GPIO7 (default) | GPIO8-GPIO15 GPIO16-GPIO23 …

params.name: GPIO pins for output
params.values: GPIO pins you want to configure GPIO0 (default) | GPIO8 GPIO16 …

params.name: Toggle GPIO#
params.values: GPIO pins you want to configure Toggle GPIO0 (default) | Toggle GPIO1 …
